thread:
Maya Chen: Short checklist before we merge the launch posts + webinar landing: keyword mapping, anchors (A/B), canonical cleanup (drop utm_source/utm_medium), JSON-LD for Article + Report, redirects plan, sitemap ping. Quick volunteers?
Evan Tran: I can do keyword mapping + meta descriptions. Will assign primary/secondary keywords per post and a recommended H1. Focusing the benchmark post on "LLM inference economics" + secondary "inference runtime optimizations".
Priya Nair: I'll do the anchor A/B and internal links. Suggest Variant A copy: "Download the Redwood benchmark" and Variant B: "Read the full benchmark report". Plan: top summary CTA + inline after H2#2 + footer link. Will avoid changing paginated tag canonicalization.
Olivia Park: Schema: Article JSON-LD for each post and Report metadata for the gated PDF. Report should set isAccessibleForFree=false and include hasPart with a short preview snippet. Will run Rich Results test on staging after deploy.
Samir Patel: Redirects: propose temporary 302 for 7 days with Cache-Control: max-age=300, flip to 301 after. I'll add an infra toggle to flip quickly. Example nginx snippet Ill include in PR. Also will strip utm_source/utm_medium server-side before building canonical.
Jeff Ramos: GTM/events: `benchmark_cta_click` (with variant tag) and `benchmark_form_impression`. Add hidden field `variant` in the form for CRM routing and cohorting. Will prepare a dashboard to monitor CTR + conversion by variant.
Maya Chen: Good. Decision: deploy as 302 with max-age 300, run A/B for 14 days, flip to 301 at day 7 if crawl and analytics look clean. Samir add smoke tests (curl follow redirects + check headers).
deploy-bot: Staging deploy: seo-launch-ab-179888 branch deployed at 1798887960 — all checks green :white_check_mark:.
Olivia Park: Rich Results test: article snippet passes; Report schema shows paywalled status (expected). Screaming Frog crawl on staging shows no duplicate canonical issues. Posting screenshots to PR.
Priya Nair: PR opened with anchor variants, canonical normalization, and sitemap updates. Tagging @Maya for final copy QA.
Evan Tran: Uploaded keyword map doc to PR (primary/secondary + meta suggestions).
Jeff Ramos: DataLayer snippet in PR: `window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || []; window.dataLayer.push({event: 'benchmark_cta_click', variant: 'A'});`
Samir Patel: Smoke test snippet: `curl -I -L -s https://staging.redwood.com/old-launch/benchmark | sed -n '1,20p'` and check for 302 + Cache-Control header. Toggle added to infra config.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Merge when green. We'll reconvene 15m after merge to validate metrics and flip redirects if stable. :rocket:
